LanguageData.IMJ_BadSippy.stages.Blergh_Bad_Sippy.des: I will continue to subsist, but at what cost? Can we call this living anymore?
LanguageData.IMJ_FineSippy.stages.Cold_Sippy.label: Cold Sippy
LanguageData.IMJ_FineSippy.stages.Cold_Sippy.descript: I ingested a hemogen pack. It nourished my body and my soul, but it was as cold as my heart.
I have ingested live hemogen, I am a god among mere mortals and immortality runs through my very veins!
